---
name: Feature request
about: Describe a research workflow that needs improvement
labels: enhancement
---

## Research need

Describe the decision you want to make and why the current workflow is insufficient. Use public or synthetic examples.

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest useful change, its inputs and the evidence a user should be able to inspect.

## Boundaries

Note any additional provider, credential, cost, privacy or browser capability required. Avoid promising exhaustive coverage or outcomes that cannot be measured.
